senses.gloss: ch. = h.<cite ref="J00720"><he>יָתוֹם</he></cite> , <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:21">Targ. O. Ex. XXII, 21</cite> (ed. Amst. <he>יִתָם</he>; Y. <cite ref="J00720"><he>יתום</he></cite>); a. e.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ bot. <he>דין די׳ וכ׳</he> the case of an orphan or a widow; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:4:7">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᶜ</cite> sq. <he>דיין דיי׳</he> (read <cite ref="D00633"><he>דין</he></cite>).
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 54a:17">Keth. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳</he> an orphan (figuratively for a hired laborer whom the employer provides with clothes, v. <cite ref="L00688"><he>לָקִיט</he> I</cite>); a. fr.—
Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ מזמורא י׳ an anonymous or titleless psalm.—Trnsf. (as a friendly rebuke) ignorant child! Keth. 17ᵇ; Ab. Zar. 13ᵇ; Ḥull. 111ᵇ.—Pl. יַתְמִין, יַתְמַיָּיא, יַתְמֵי.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:23">Targ. Ex. XXII, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:14">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>זוזי די׳</he> heirs’ fund. Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ bot., a. e., <he>מדל די׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00303"><he>מְדִל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a">B. Mets. 108ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 8a">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ מִיַּ׳</he> even orphans’ funds must be taxed, v. <cite ref="A00301"><he>אִגְלָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:11">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אתון י׳ וכ׳</he> the heirs came complaining; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:7">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>קרו לנפשייהו י׳</he> they (the surviving scholars) called themselves orphans; <he>י׳ די׳</he> orphans of orphans (few survivors).
